chunks.head: leave off
chunks.note: leave off (doing sth) = 停止做某事、不再继续;也指戒掉某习惯。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'离开'义,与 off 合成'停止'

chunks.ex_en: She left off talking when the teacher came in.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师进来时她停止了说话。

chunks.head: go abroad
chunks.note: go abroad = 出国(留学、工作、旅行等)。
chunks.ex_en: Many students want to go abroad to study.

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在两件事之间的这段时间里、与此同时。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is at seven; in the meantime, let's play a game.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭七点吃,在这之前我们先玩个游戏吧。

chunks.head: break loose
chunks.note: break loose = 挣脱束缚、逃脱;也指(骚乱、混乱)突然爆发。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'脱离束缚的状态'

chunks.ex_en: The dog broke loose and ran into the park.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只狗挣脱开,跑进了公园。

chunks.head: reflect upon
chunks.note: reflect on/upon sth = 仔细思考、回想、反省某事。
chunks.ex_en: At night she likes to reflect upon her day.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚上她喜欢回想这一天。

chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: in a word = 概括地说、总而言之。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,这次旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: bound for
chunks.note: bound for + 地点 = (车、船、飞机)开往某地。

literal.note_cn: 此处形容词,非'跳跃/边界'义

chunks.ex_en: This train is bound for Beijing.

chunks.head: a great many
chunks.note: a great many + 复数名词 = 很多、非常多。
chunks.ex_en: A great many people came to the show.

chunks.head: on foot
chunks.note: on foot = 徒步、步行(去某地)。
chunks.ex_en: We went to school on foot every day.

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.note: meet with sth = 遭遇(困难、事故、反对等);也表(正式)会面。本章为'遭遇'义。
chunks.ex_en: The plan met with a lot of problems.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个计划遇到了很多问题。

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.note: wear off = (疼痛、新鲜感、药效等)逐渐减弱、消失。

literal.note_cn: 此处'渐渐消退',非'穿戴/磨损'

chunks.ex_en: After an hour the medicine began to wear off.
chunks.ex_cn: 一小时后药效开始消退。

chunks.head: look out for
chunks.note: look out for = 留心寻找、物色某物;也表'当心、提防'。本章为'物色(一次航行)'义。
chunks.ex_en: I'm looking out for a cheap flight to Tokyo.
chunks.ex_cn: 我在物色一张去东京的便宜机票。

chunks.head: burst out
chunks.note: burst out = 突然(激烈地)发作;burst out laughing/crying = 突然大笑/大哭。
chunks.ex_en: She burst out laughing at his joke.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到他的笑话,她突然大笑起来。
